role: Route design, evaluation, operation, and security work for AI-agent systems.
notes: Choose the narrowest concern at F-AE1; shared engineering and security skills remain single-copy dual links.

children.note: Core agent-system leaves. Workflow observation analyzes one fixed completed/paused snapshot and returns proposals only; tool-schema work preserves design/review/authorized-edit mode and returns to its MCP, oversight, security or hub caller; provider/live-effect tests require separate authority.

Shared implementation skills; agent observability inherits the exact caller/candidate/worktree/authority, separates operational metadata from sensitive content, and returns without hosted telemetry operations

Primary membership remains under the Review security sub-hub. Pass caller mode, candidate, scope and permitted checks. Prompt-injection assessment returns evidence, not automatic tool redesign; package review returns a recommendation and coverage gaps, never installation, edits or live quarantine.

pipeline: use F-AE1 only for material ambiguity
run one leaf and return its candidate, evidence, effects, and limits to the caller

forks.question: Which one agent-system outcome is required?
forks.recommended: Infer the narrowest evidence-backed specialist; ask only when two outcomes materially differ
